text:
olivia_partnerships: ACME just pinged — they want a private offer for the Appliance+Support bundle. Key asks: 24mo graduated commit, NFR trial, co-announcement in Q3. Can we sketch pricing tiers + renewal protection? cc @sam_sales @ben_finance
sam_sales: They're a good fit. My read: they want ramped discounts to align with usage growth. Proposed tiers: 250k -> 10%, 500k -> 15%, 1M -> 22%. Thoughts?
ben_finance: Numbers look ok as starting point. Need to check cost floor with HW rebates. Also add clause: min annual consumption 60% of commit or apply true-up. We should model ARR impact. Ping @tara_product for announcement windows.
tara_product: For co-annc, keep comms simple. If we do a joint PR, marketing needs 6 weeks prep. Q3 slot looks tight if contract signs < 8 weeks from now. Also: require pre-approval of messaging.
nora_ops: On the private offer setup: marketplace listing needs SKU mapping + seller ID. Prep lead time ~3 business days after legal signs. For VPC/on-prem delivery, coord with infra for on-site scheduling.
olivia_partnerships: Agree on min-consumption clause. One ask from ACME: preserve right to pause commit for a certified HW failure event. Ben — can we offer a 30-day pause window for force majeure?
ben_finance: 30 days seems fine but limit to once per 12 months. Also propose renewal protection: if they grow >20% we auto-step up discount; if they shrink, hold band for first renewal year.
sam_sales: I'll float these on the next call. Also suggesting a pilot: 3mo NFR with commit credit if convert. Helps close faster. :thumbsup:
olivia_partnerships: Pilot accepted by ACME in principle. Tara — can you own comms gating and marketing prep? Nora — set up marketplace flow and SKU draft.
tara_product: On it. I'll draft a press plan and coordinate legal copy review. ETA: first draft in 4 business days.
nora_ops: I'll start the SKU mapping and share the marketplace checklist. Need ACME's billing address + reseller contact.
deploy-bot: Reminder: create private-offer draft in CRM and tag deal-stage=proposal — /create-offer 3923456789
sam_sales: Putting note in CRM now. I'll schedule follow-up call for Wed next week. Thanks all.
